description: Opening hours, last-entry times and ticket prices for the museums in Iași, evaluated on Bucharest wall-clock time — right now by default. Each result carries `state` (code open / closing-soon / last-entry-passed / opens-later / closed / closure, the Romanian label the iasi.io board shows, `opens`, `closes`, `lastEntry` (null when the museum publishes none), and `canEnter` whenever a time applies), the weekly `hours` (mon–sun, null = closed), `tickets` in lei (full, student, pensioner; 0 is no such fare, and `full: 0` is free entry), `combinedTicket` in lei where the museum's `building` sells one ticket covering all of its museums, `visitMinutes`, the `building` it shares, and `events` — that day's avizier events at the museum (null when that source is unreachable). `date` picks another day (with no `time`, the whole day's programme), `time` (HH:MM) an hour, `open: true` keeps only museums whose doors are open then, `zone` (Centru, Copou, Țicău) and `maxPriceRon` (full ticket) filter, and `query` naming a museum or a building (Palatul Culturii, Casa Muzeelor) narrows to it — other words are ignored. The hours are the current schedule and there is no history: a past `date` gets a no-history answer, not a guess. Every museum is closed on Monday; one with no published last entry admits visitors until it closes.
name: find_museums
